summary: Iteration 11 (Phase 7 finalization + pricing pro update) — All backend and frontend checks PASS. 9/9 pytest tests green. Pricing pro tab shows the 4 expected cards (99€/990€/199€/1990€). GET /api/plans?audience=pro returns amount_cents 9900/99000/19900/199000 (subset check). Push endpoints (/api/push/public-key, /subscribe, /unsubscribe, /test) all return 200 with expected payloads. Admin retention digest endpoint returns {ok:true, sent:N}. PUT /api/users/me/preferences updates weekly_digest correctly. Frontend Login → Dashboard redirect produces ZERO React setState-during-render warnings. Push toggle button present on Dashboard with data-testid='push-toggle-btn' (shown as 'Push bloqué' because Playwright headless denies Notification permission — expected). Nav 'Parrainer' link href='/inviter' and the new /inviter page renders invite-code (CP-M5H5HJ), filleuls (0), crédit accumulé (0.00 €), share card with 5 buttons (WhatsApp/Facebook/X/Email/Copier) and email invite input + Envoyer button — all with required data-testid attributes. Sanity: /api/ 200, /api/estimation/analyse 200, /api/prices/search (POST) 200, /sw.js served 200.

minor.issue: Reuses PushSubIn model which requires 'keys' field. Semantically, unsubscribe should only need 'endpoint'. Not blocking (client sends full sub object), but consider a dedicated PushUnsubIn model with only endpoint required.

critical_code_review_comments: Push unsubscribe endpoint reuses PushSubIn requiring keys — cosmetic API contract issue only.
Test agent had to close an onboarding modal to interact with nav (modal not intercepting header links, so no functional bug — just noting).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 7 fully validated on iter11. Push toggle in headless Playwright shows 'Push bloqué' because browser denies Notification permission — this is NOT a bug. To exercise real push flow, use a real browser with permissions granted. Login endpoint returns {token, session_token, user} — use 'token' key (not 'access_token'). /api/prices/search is POST with body {query, limit}.
